race.title: All-Weather Championship Is Back Handicap (Div 1)
race.verdict: RED HAT EAGLE is threatening to come good so gets the vote after joining a yard that has a strong record with new recruits. Phoenix of Dreams remains of firm interest back on all-weather and looks the clear next best. RED HAT EAGLE PHOENIX OF DREAMS (IRE) FLOWSTATE (IRE)
